scoring_rule: Primary calibration score uses all 23 resolved queries for predicted visibility accuracy and the 22 resolved visible items for point-in-box, box IoU, and small-object metrics. Item_14 remains ambiguous by both primary labelers and is excluded. Item_11 is deliberately ambiguous and remains explicitly flagged; report its per-query result and a sensitivity score excluding it. First-pass agreeing boxes use coordinate-wise mean references; third-agent adjudications replace both first-pass labels on the nine disputed queries. No held-out material is included.

not_scored_reason.instance_accuracy_given_localization: Neither model emits a labeler instance_id and labels do not enumerate competing frame instances; identity cannot be measured independently of box overlap.
not_scored_reason.small_object_accuracy: No scorable agreed visible query has consensus box area <= 0.01 of the source frame.
not_scored_reason.spatial_relationship_accuracy: The adapters emit point/box geometry, not a predicted relation class.
